Comment.value: Harvest of Shadows leaderboard currency. Given straight into the party's packs by HW_GiveGuts (no ground drop) and handed in at the Gourd Board (hw_board_turn, counted by tag). Base 49 (potions) purely for the 99 stack and the orange jar icon (it_potion 72); it has no properties, so it cannot be drunk. Cost 1 so it is never a gold farm.

value.0: Stringy orange pulp and seeds from a broken jack-o'-lantern. Still faintly warm. The Gourd Board in the Well of Eru counts these.
